drivingQuestion: How could R' Akiva give time when no time is given for injuries?

segments.he: וּמַעֲשֶׂה בְּאֶחָד שֶׁפָּרַע רֹאשׁ הָאִשָּׁה [וְכוּ׳]. וּמִי יָהֲבִינַן זְמַן? וְהָאָמַר רַבִּי חֲנִינָא: אֵין נוֹתְנִין זְמַן לַחֲבָלוֹת!
segments.en: § The mishna relates: «And an incident» occurred «involving one who uncovered the head of a woman» in the marketplace. The woman came before Rabbi Akiva to request that he assess payment for the humiliation that she suffered, and Rabbi Akiva obligated the assailant to give her four hundred dinars. The man said to Rabbi Akiva: My teacher, give me time to pay the penalty, and Rabbi Akiva gave him time. The Gemara asks: «But do we give time» for an assailant to pay compensation? «But doesn’t Rabbi Ḥanina say:» The court «does not give» one «time» to provide payment «for injuries,» and he must pay compensation immediately.
